summary: Computational biologist working on single-cell transcriptomics and gene-regulatory network inference, with six peer-reviewed publications.

items.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
bullets: Develop probabilistic models for inferring regulatory networks from single-cell RNA-seq data.
Built a Nextflow pipeline that processes 1.2 million cells per run on the institute cluster.
Co-supervise two doctoral students and one master's student.
Wrote the computational aims of a successful DBT grant proposal worth INR 1.4 crore.
Maintain the lab's shared reference atlas and its documentation.
Organise the fortnightly computational journal club.

items.title: Research Intern
bullets: Benchmarked six batch-correction methods on 40 public datasets.
Contributed a Python package for metric computation that is now used by two other groups.

items.title: Teaching Assistant
bullets: Taught tutorials for the graduate course on statistical genomics for three years.
Designed weekly R programming assignments and graded 60 students per term.
